records.text: then may the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, trample my life into the earth, and make my glory dwell in dust. Diapsalma.
For the end. A psalm of David. In the Lord I have trusted. How will you say to my soul, “Move away to the mountains like a little bird”?
But I, in righteousness, will appear before Thy face; I will be satisfied when Thy glory appears.
They were fettered and fell, but we rose and were set upright.
He will guide the meek in judgment; He will teach the meek His ways.
When those doing evil approached me to eat my flesh, those who afflict me and my enemies, they grew weak and fell.
And now, behold, He raised my head above my enemies; I went around and sacrificed in His tent a sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and make music to the Lord.
The Lord is my helper and my protector; in Him my heart hoped, and I was helped, and my flesh blossomed anew; from my own will I will thank Him.
But against me they rejoiced and gathered; scourges gathered against me, and I did not know; they were torn apart and felt no remorse.
For I am ready for scourges, and my pain is continually before me.
